name: rising2-server-launcher
description: Not a Node project: these scripts only wrap the Docker (MinGW) builds of the C programs.

scripts.build: npm run build:image && docker run --rm -v ./src:/src -v ./bin:/out rising2/mingw32
scripts.build-tools: npm run build:image && docker run --rm -v ./tools:/src -w /src rising2/mingw32 sh -c "i686-w64-mingw32-gcc -O2 -s -Wall -o lvdump.exe lvdump.c -luser32 -static-libgcc && i686-w64-mingw32-gcc -O2 -s -Wall -o sampler.exe sampler.c -static-libgcc"
